caseStudy.overview: F&N's ordering platform lets outlets and distributors order stock directly. As the primary developer at Flow Digital, I maintained the live React Native eOrder MY application and built the Flutter replacement, F&N GO. The replacement development period shown here is July 2024 to June 2025; legacy maintenance covered 2023–2024.

sections.title: A foundation for the whole product
sections.text: Defined the layered architecture and Riverpod state management, built typed domain models, and centralized API access. Carried the existing ordering and outlet-specific business rules into the replacement application.

sections.title: Ordering, promotions, and loyalty
sections.text: Delivered catalogue, cart, checkout, and order history, with FOC and purchase-with-purchase promotion rules. Built points balances, history, and expiry alongside voucher shopping, redemption, inventory, and checkout integration.

sections.title: Beyond the Flutter layer
sections.text: Integrated AWS Cognito authentication and device-integrity checks. Wrote Kotlin platform-channel code and Huawei messaging integration so push notifications could reach devices without Google Play Services, alongside Firebase messaging on GMS devices.

sections.title: Taking it into production
sections.text: Owned Android and iOS release work, signing configuration, versioned releases, update checks, and production/staging configuration. Delivered three interface languages and consistent offline, maintenance, and error states.

delivery: Released on Google Play and the Apple App Store
Primary developer across architecture, features, and release delivery
